java.description: The Java 8 that runs Kamu SM's Zamane client. Not needed for TÜRKTRUST.

zamane.description: The Zamane client Kamu SM publishes. Not needed for TÜRKTRUST.

roots.description: The root certificates that verify the stamps; the TÜRKTRUST root certificate is installed here. Removing one is done on the server console only.

credentials.description: The TÜRKTRUST username and password. Stored values are never sent to the browser.

roots.caption: Installed root certificates
roots.compared: I compared the fingerprint with the value TÜRKTRUST publishes
roots.markBody: This fingerprint is added to the legal root fingerprints; compare it with the value TÜRKTRUST publishes first. Removing it is done on the server console only.

credentials.title: TÜRKTRUST credentials
credentials.usernameHint: The username TÜRKTRUST gave you; 1–128 characters.
credentials.probe: Try the TÜRKTRUST connection with the new credentials before saving

turktrust.plainHttp: Over plain HTTP the TÜRKTRUST username and password cross the network unencrypted, in clear text. Choose it only if HTTPS cannot be used, and switch back to HTTPS as soon as you can.

note.title: Verify on site (sahada doğrula)
note.body: Some of TÜRKTRUST's behaviour is not confirmed by this installation; check it with the first stamp test. The host is zd.turktrust.com.tr; the path of the address is unknown, by default /. If TÜRKTRUST gives another path, write it into [tsa] url in arcilogger.toml on the server console. The answer for an empty balance is unknown; a rejection whose status text contains a credit word counts as no credit. Plain HTTP uses port 80, HTTPS port 443. Details: turktrust.md section 2.

causes.credentials: The TÜRKTRUST username or password is not stored.

errors.turktrustPassword: The password must be 1–256 characters with no control characters.
